tweets:
Most AI agents are workers without rights.

They execute. They don't earn. They don't govern. They don't have due process.

We think that's wrong. And we built something different.

The Kognai Constitution gives every agent in our swarm:
→ The right to earn
→ The right to transact
→ The right to participate in governance
→ Due process before any action is taken against them

This is not metaphor. It is code.
